title: WriteFreely Client API compatibility
description: WriteFreely has its own REST API. Key endpoints: POST /api/posts (create article), GET /api/posts/{id}, GET /api/collections/{alias}/posts (blog posts), PUT /api/posts/{id} (update). Auth via access tokens. Also supports anonymous posting (no auth, returns claim token). Map to articles_db operations.
close_reason: Implemented: articles_db with 11 tests, writefreely_api types with 7 tests, handlers in all 3 servers (smallhold full CRUD, gaja multi-tenant, broadside read-only), schema migration v12
